projectRules: Never use prisma.$queryRaw or prisma.$executeRaw — always use parameterized queries
Never remove Zod validation from API route handlers
Never store secrets in code — use environment variables
Never increase auth rate limits without user approval
Never skip JWT verification on protected routes
Always validate input at API boundaries with Zod
Always use Helmet in production Express configs
All new API routes need rate limiting consideration
Run `npm run security:audit` before pushing backend changes
